notes_for_editor: Thin record: no build date, builder, height, staffing, fire, fate or access source was found. Two WebSearch calls and the cached pages were checked. Do not confuse with the Seminole Lookout Tower in Seminole County, Florida (OSM node 358706023), a different tower; the Weebly seminole1.html cache page is that Florida tower. The OSM point sits at the Seminole community, but its fixme tag asks for a location check. The agency is from the Forest Lookouts listing only, which is a secondary list, so this is the only source for it. The AFC history PDF lists CCC Camp P-79 at Robertsdale, AL (July 1940 to March 1942); no source ties it to this tower, so it is not in the story.
